The '''Innton system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Sluis sector/Legends|Sluis sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Innton II]].<ref name="SoR" />
